## Non-negotiables

- Validate every input at the boundary (DTO / Zod); one error envelope for the whole API.
- Field names mirror the source (DB / upstream) — no renaming mappers.
- No N+1: load relations in one query; brainstorm complex queries before writing them.
- Auth and ownership checks on every route that touches user data.
- Migrations are additive and reversible; never edit an applied migration.

## Done means

Build, typecheck and tests pass; your reply lists changed endpoints with request/response shape changes.
